description.value: GoodSide Pastry House is a Victoria neighbourhood pastry shop founded in 2020 by pastry chefs Haley Landa and Curtis Helm, each with over a decade of professional kitchen experience. The shop specializes in Euro-style cakes, croissants, and pastries crafted with traditional French techniques and West Coast-inspired flavours and ingredients. A rotating monthly menu and pre-order custom cakes make it a distinctive artisan food stop on Fort Street.
